description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for LobsterWars — TypeScript + Phaser + Matter.js

rules.name: Server handler reading client input without validation
rules.message: Server message handler uses client input fields without server-side validation — trust boundary violation
rules.suggestion: Validate all client-sent values server-side: type, range, sanity. Never trust client gameplay values.

rules.name: WebSocket connection without auth middleware
rules.message: WebSocket 'connection' handler does not verify authentication token — unauthenticated access
rules.suggestion: Add auth middleware: verify JWT/session token before accepting connection. Use socket.io middleware or handleUpgrade auth.

rules.name: setTimeout in game physics context
rules.message: setTimeout used in game physics/logic context — timing-based resolution instead of simulation
rules.suggestion: Replace setTimeout-based projectile resolution with per-frame physics step in the game loop

rules.name: Matter.js body without collisionFilter
rules.message: Matter.js body created without collisionFilter — uncontrolled collision behavior
rules.suggestion: Add collisionFilter: { category: CATEGORY_PLAYER, mask: CATEGORY_ENEMY | CATEGORY_WALL } to each body

rules.name: In-memory Map/Set for room state without persistence
rules.message: Room/match state stored in plain Map/Set — lost on server restart
rules.suggestion: Use Redis adapter (socket.io-redis-adapter) or database for room state persistence and horizontal scaling
